headline: Profit dips on one-off costs; full-year guidance held
summary_short: NiSource's Q2 FY2026 GAAP EPS fell to $0.09 from $0.22 a year ago on net income of $45.5M, as revenue rose 3.4% y/y to $1,289.5M but absorbed $21.4M of NIPSCO workplace-continuity costs and $5.4M of Value Captured restructuring charges.
summary_long: GAAP net income fell to $45.5M ($0.09 diluted EPS) from $102.2M ($0.22) a year earlier, as $42.8M of adjustments to operating income — $21.4M in NIPSCO workplace-continuity costs from an April lockout, $5.4M in Value Captured restructuring, and a $16.0M unfavorable weather variance — pulled GAAP operating income down 13.6% y/y to $228.1M. Non-GAAP consolidated adjusted EPS was $0.16, down from $0.22. The steep q/q declines (EPS -91.5%, revenue -44.5%) reflect NiSource's normal seasonal falloff from its Q1 winter heating-season peak, not a business deterioration. The company reaffirmed 2026 non-GAAP consolidated adjusted EPS guidance of $2.02-$2.07 and its 9%-10% EPS CAGR through 2033, continuing its $28.6B 2026-2030 capital investment plan. Cash stood at $70.0M against $9,574.6M of shareholders' equity.
